Dismeigh

VTuber • Car Enthusiast • Voice Actor • Creative Developer

Heyo, I’m Dismeigh! Pronounced like dismay, but with way better vibes. I’m a VTuber in progress, a car nerd at heart, and someone who can bounce from stream chaos to garage talk to random voice lines without warning. Oh, and I’m a voice actor, so talking to myself is officially part of the job now! I also build websites and tools through Denizen Technologies, but this place is mainly for the streams, the builds, the laughs, and the people riding along!
